indication_area: Cystic fibrosis patients with Pseudomonas aeruginosa (improvement of respiratory symptoms)
geography: Worldwide (Gilead's stated Cayston sales; the United States and certain countries of Europe)
formulation: lyophilized powder for inhalation solution (with Altera nebulizer)

approval_evidence.quote: CAYSTON AZTREONAM 75MG/VIAL FOR SOLUTION;INHALATION ... 02/22/2010 ORIG-1 Approval Type 3 - New Dosage Form
approval_evidence.note: first_approval_year 2009 is the European conditional marketing authorization (Gilead 10-K for 2009: 'In September 2009, the European Commission granted conditional marketing authorization for Cayston for patients with CF aged 18 years and older.'); the FDA record is the 2010 U.S. approval.

launch_evidence.quote: Also, Cayston sales in the United States contributed $18.5 million to our second quarter 2011 product sales, an increase of 98% over the same period in 2010 as Cayston launched in the first quarter of 2010.

series_start_reason: Series starts 2010Q1, the launch quarter. Gilead's product tables never carry a Cayston line; every row is the product's own figure stated in a sentence of the release or Form 10-Q (2010Q1 from the prior-year comparison in the first-quarter 2011 release).
series_end_reason: Gilead's last Cayston figure is in the third-quarter 2011 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882095/000119312511284200/d248092dex991.htm: 'Sales of Cayston were $23.6 million for the third quarter of 2011'). The fourth-quarter 2011 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882095/000119312512036780/d291114dex991.htm) states only 'Sales of other products were $151.1 million for the fourth quarter of 2011 ... and included AmBisome ..., Hepsera ..., Emtriva ... and Cayston', and later filings name Cayston only inside 'Other' (e.g. first-quarter 2022 release footnote '(7) Includes Cayston, Jyseleca, Ranexa and Zydelig.').
search_log: Listed every Gilead Sciences (CIK 882095) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages (all forms); earnings releases are the 8-K/8-K/A filings with item 2.02 from 2009, each exhibit resolved from index.json; plus every 10-Q and 10-K from 2009.

Every table row whose first cell starts with Cayston, Tecartus, Veklury, Zydelig or Yeztugo followed by a figure was extracted from all of those documents (scan.py); for a product printed as regional lines ('<product> – U.S.', '– Europe', '– Other International' / 'Rest of World', or from 2026 '<product> | U.S.' then 'Europe', 'Rest of World'), the figure is the unlabelled worldwide total line beneath them, never a sum computed here.
Each quarter is read from the release that reports it as current (filed in the month after quarter end; Q4 in January/February).

Cayston has no table row in any Gilead release, 10-Q or 10-K (the only 'Cayston' rows are the patent-expiry tables of the Forms 10-K); the narrative of every 2009-2012 release, 10-Q and 10-K was searched for sentences stating a Cayston sales figure (sent.py / grepall.py).
2010: 2.9 + 10.5 + 14.7 + 19.4 = 47.5, equal to the full year stated in the fourth-quarter 2010 release.
